blocked_by.details: Obligation claims 'Under the EU AI Act' but cites CITE:nist-ai-rmf (jurisdiction=US, authority_type=standard). Not acceptable as authority anchor for EU legal obligation.
EU legal obligation claims require authority_type in {statute,regulation,official_guidance} and jurisdiction compatible with EU.

return: Replace citation with correct EU AI Act authority anchors (CITE:* with jurisdiction=EU and authority_type=official_guidance/statute/regulation).
If only best-practice standards are available, rephrase claim as 'recommended practice' and remove legal obligation language.
Route to HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED if uncertainty persists on scope or tier.
